description: Tasks template for modernization plan. Generated alongside plan.md to track individual migration tasks.

tasks.description: Upgrade the SupplyChain Frontend from Java 8 / Spring Boot 2.7.18 to Java 21 / Spring Boot 3.x
tasks.reason: The application uses Java 8 and Spring Boot 2.7.18, both of which are end of OSS support. Upgrading to Java 21 and Spring Boot 3.x provides long-term support, security patches, and compatibility with modern Azure services.
tasks.requirements: Upgrade Java from 8 to 21, Spring Boot from 2.7.18 to the latest 3.x, and Spring Framework from 5.x to 6.x. Migrate javax.* namespace to jakarta.* (javax.servlet:jstl to jakarta equivalent). Update WAR packaging and Tomcat dependencies as needed for Spring Boot 3.x compatibility. Ensure all existing functionality (JSP views, RestTemplate-based backend API calls) continues to work after the upgrade.

tasks.description: Validate and fix all CVE vulnerabilities in project dependencies
tasks.reason: The user requires all CVE issues to be resolved to ensure the application meets security compliance standards before Azure deployment.
tasks.requirements: Scan all project dependencies for known CVE vulnerabilities, update vulnerable dependencies to secure versions, and verify that no critical or high CVE issues remain after remediation.

tasks.description: Update the Dockerfile to use modern base images compatible with Java 21 and Spring Boot 3.x
tasks.reason: The existing Dockerfile uses maven:3.8-openjdk-8 and tomcat:8.5-jdk8 base images which are incompatible with the upgraded Java 21 / Spring Boot 3.x stack.
tasks.requirements: Update the Dockerfile to use Java 21 base images. Update build and runtime stages to match the upgraded project. Ensure the container builds and runs successfully with the modernized application.
